note: Under New Zealand law all Niueans are New Zealand citizens, as New Zealand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade says; New Zealand issues no national identity card, so they hold none.

sources.title: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Niue
sources.said: under New Zealand law, all Niueans are New Zealand citizens

sources.title: Department of Internal Affairs, OIA 2526-1378, Appendix A (as published by the Free Speech Union)
sources.said: New Zealand does not have, and is not planning to create, a single national ID, digital ID or unique
